title: 2040年代家用录像（记忆）
text: 2040年代的家用手持摄像机/手机自动模式拍摄：自动曝光在窗光里来回呼吸，对焦偶尔寻找，低码率压缩产生块状噪点和暗部色噪，暖米色褪色，黑位发灰。Consumer handheld family camera of the 2040s on auto: exposure pumping in window light, focus hunting, low-bitrate macroblocking and chroma noise, warm faded beige, lifted greyish blacks, framing at a parent's hip or a child's eye level.

title: 2050年代研究院影像档案
text: 研究院自己的观察式记录片档案：Super 16 彩色负片，推一档冲洗，颗粒活跃；荧光灯管偏青绿，一盏暖台灯作为唯一暖源；低饱和，深阴影，变焦镜头远远地看人做事。Institute observational archive on Super 16 colour negative pushed one stop: lively grain, a green-cyan fluorescent cast with one warm practical desk lamp as the only warm source, muted palette, deep shadows, a documentary zoom watching people work from across the room.

title: 2058年新闻资料影像（灾难现场）
text: 肩扛广播级 ENG 摄像机，磁带转录：隔行扫描的软、淡扫描线、红色拖影、高光溢出、暗部发闷；记者跟着人跑，构图仓促，镜头常被人挡住。Shoulder-mounted ENG broadcast camera dubbed from tape: interlaced softness, faint scan lines, chroma smear on reds, clipped hot whites, murky crushed shadows; the operator runs with the crew, framing is hurried and often blocked by passing bodies.

title: 2075年现场纪实（危机）
text: 高感光全画幅纪录片摄影机手持，只用现场光：警报红光、监视器冷光、手电。噪点明显，黑位扎实，烟雾里的体积光与剪影；人脸和关键物件必须清楚，其余交给黑暗。High-ISO full-frame documentary camera handheld in available light only (alarm red, monitor glow, flashlights): visible noise, solid blacks, volumetric haze and silhouettes; faces and key objects stay readable, everything else is surrendered to darkness.

title: 2078年口述史采访布光
text: 口述史采访：三脚架锁定，50mm f/2.8，主光一盏柔光从画左45度打来，右侧负补光让脸有落差；背景是虚化的管道和一盏暖色小灯作为纵深；人物略偏离中心，视线越过镜头看采访者。Oral-history interview: locked tripod, 50mm at f/2.8, one soft key 45 degrees from frame left, negative fill on the right for falloff, out-of-focus pipes and one small warm lamp for depth, subject slightly off centre looking past the lens at the interviewer.

title: 资料退化：DV/低码率数字录像
text: 低码率数字录像的退化：运动时出现块状压缩，暗部色噪，锐化过度的边缘，白平衡在室内外之间漂移。Low-bitrate digital video degradation: blocking on motion, chroma noise in shadows, over-sharpened edges, white balance drifting between rooms.

title: 资料退化：磁带与扫描线
text: 磁带转录的资料：淡淡的扫描线，偶尔一条滚动噪带，红色向右拖影，画面边缘轻微抖动。Tape-dubbed archive: faint scan lines, an occasional rolling noise bar, red bleeding to the right, a slight jitter at the frame edge.

title: 资料退化：胶片划痕与漏光
text: 旧胶片档案：零星灰尘和细划痕，片头片尾的漏光，曝光在帧与帧之间轻微起伏。Old film archive: specks of dust and hairline scratches, light leaks at roll ends, exposure breathing slightly from frame to frame.

title: 地下城工业纪实质感
text: 地下城的纪实质感：冷凝水沿管道往下滴，蒸汽从格栅里冒，钢板上有手写编号被磨掉的痕迹，灯具是裸露的灯管和防爆灯；不要光鲜的科幻设计，一切都是用旧了的工业品。Underground-city documentary texture: condensation dripping along pipes, steam from grilles, worn steel plates, bare tubes and caged lamps; no glossy sci-fi design, everything is used industrial hardware.

title: 实验室与机房的真实感
text: 实验室的真实感：工作台上堆着示波器、线圈、焊锡、喝了一半的茶，机房玻璃后面是冷白的机柜灯带；人物衣服有折痕，桌面有划痕。A real lab: oscilloscopes, coils, solder and a half-finished cup of tea on the bench, cold white cabinet light strips behind the glass; creased clothes and a scratched desk.

title: 被淹的机房与集结区
text: 被淹机房：探照灯在黑水上打出长长的反光，水面漂着电缆和泡沫板，人的腿在水里拖出波纹，应急灯在远处闪。Flooded server hall: floodlights throw long reflections on black water, cables and foam boards float, legs drag ripples, emergency lights blink far away.

title: 冰原与压顶的天体
text: 冰原外景：风把雪横着吹过镜头，远处熄火的发动机只剩剪影，天体压满半个天空，光是暗橙色的、没有温度。Ice plain exterior: wind drives snow sideways across the lens, a dead engine stands as a silhouette, a planet fills half the sky in a dull, heatless orange.

title: 转场：形状匹配剪辑
text: 形状匹配：上一镜头结尾和下一镜头开头在同一画面位置有相似的形状（红色的圆、方盒子、交叉的线），剪切发生在动作或形状重合的那一帧。Shape match cut: the end of one shot and the start of the next share a similar shape at the same place in frame (a red circle, a square box, crossing lines); cut on the frame where they coincide.

title: 转场：动作匹配剪辑
text: 动作匹配：同一个手势跨越时空延续，比如一只手递出盒子，下一镜头另一只手在另一个年代接住。Gesture match cut: one gesture continues across time, a hand passes a box and the next shot catches it in another decade.

title: 转场：白闪与曝光闪
text: 白闪：两到四帧过曝到白，用在记忆闪回和年代跳跃；比硬切柔和，又比叠化更有冲击。White or exposure flash: two to four frames blown out to white for memory flashes and jumps in time; softer than a hard cut, sharper than a dissolve.

title: 转场：J剪与L剪
text: J剪：下一镜头的声音提前进入；L剪：上一镜头的声音延续到下一镜头。用声音把不同年代连起来，画面切换就不突兀。J cut: the next shot's sound arrives early; L cut: the previous shot's sound carries over. Sound bridges stitch eras together so picture cuts never feel abrupt.

title: 转场：甩镜
text: 甩镜：镜头快速横甩产生运动模糊，在模糊最强的一帧接到下一个也在甩的镜头。Whip pan: a fast lateral swing smears the frame; cut at the blurriest frame into another whip.

title: 采访布光：单一柔光主光
text: 采访主光：一盏大面积柔光从侧前方打来，脸上有明暗过渡，眼睛里有一个小而柔的眼神光，背景比人暗一档到两档。Interview key: one large soft source from the front side, a gradient across the face, a small soft catchlight, background one to two stops below the face.

title: 现场光：台灯与暖色实用光
text: 实用光：画面里的台灯就是主光，光圈小小一团，人脸只有朝灯的一侧亮，其余沉进阴影。Practical light: the desk lamp in frame is the key, a small pool of light, only the side of the face toward the lamp lit.

title: 现场光：警报红光与监视器冷光
text: 危机现场的光：头顶警报灯一下一下扫过红色，监视器从下方给脸补一层冷蓝，两种光交替。Crisis light: an alarm beacon sweeps red from above, monitors underlight faces in cold blue, the two alternate.

title: 现场光：手电与停电
text: 停电里的手电：光圈小而硬，边缘有一圈晕，人脸只靠纸面反光照亮，空气里的灰尘被光柱照出来。Blackout flashlight: a small hard pool with a soft halo, faces lit only by bounce off paper, dust visible in the beam.

title: 现场光：午后窗光
text: 午后窗光：阳光从窗户斜进来，在桌面上铺出一块亮斑，灰尘在光里浮，逆光把孩子的头发勾出一圈亮边。Afternoon window light: a slanted patch of sun on the table, dust floating in it, backlight rimming a child's hair.

title: 机位：采访固定机位
text: 采访机位：三脚架锁定，中近景，人物在三分线上，鼻子方向留出空间；最多一个几乎察觉不到的慢推。Interview camera: locked tripod, medium close-up, subject on a third with nose room; at most one barely perceptible slow push.

title: 机位：纪实手持跟拍
text: 纪实手持：摄影师肩扛跟着人走，反应总慢半拍，构图在动作发生后才修正，偶尔被前景的人挡一下。Verite handheld: shoulder-mounted, reacting half a beat late, reframing after the action happens, occasionally blocked by someone in the foreground.

title: 机位：细节特写插入
text: 插入特写：手持贴近物件，焦点在物件最关键的一点上呼吸，背景完全化开。Insert close-up: handheld close to the object, focus breathing on its key detail, background fully dissolved.

title: 机位：长焦远观
text: 长焦远观：远远地看，空间被压扁，前景有遮挡物虚化掠过，人物不知道被拍。Long-lens observation: from far away, space compressed, soft foreground obstructions drifting past, the subject unaware of the camera.

title: 运镜：慢推揭示
text: 慢推揭示：从能看清环境的景别开始，极慢地推到关键物件或眼睛，推的终点就是这个镜头要说的东西。Slow push reveal: start wide enough to read the place, creep in to the key object or the eyes; the end of the push is the point of the shot.

title: 运镜：绕到侧面
text: 缓慢弧线：从人物背后开始，绕到侧面，让观众先看到她看的东西，再看到她的脸。Slow arc: start behind the subject and drift round to her side, so the audience sees what she sees before seeing her face.

title: 情绪：克制的悲伤
text: 克制的悲伤：不哭出声，只是停顿、低头、吸一口气，眼眶发红但不落泪；动作变慢，沉默比台词长。Restrained grief: no crying aloud, only a pause, lowered eyes, a breath, eyes reddening without tears; movement slows and silence outlasts the line.

title: 情绪：意识到的那一刻
text: 意识到的那一刻：人物一动不动，只有眼睛在动，嘴唇微张，呼吸停住半拍，然后很轻地说出一句话。The moment of realisation: the body freezes, only the eyes move, lips part, breath stops for half a beat, then one quiet line.

title: 情绪：家里的温暖
text: 家里的温暖：随手的抚摸、笑出声、孩子靠到大人身上，镜头跟着笑声晃一下。Domestic warmth: a casual touch, laughter, a child leaning into an adult, the camera wobbling with the laugh.

title: 情绪：微小的希望
text: 微小的希望：黑暗里一点一点亮起的小灯，不是一下子全亮，节奏像呼吸；人物只是长出一口气。Small hope: tiny lights coming on one by one in the dark, not all at once, at the rhythm of breathing; the person only exhales.

title: 声音：采访间底噪
text: 采访间声音：安静的房间底噪，远处通风管的低频，衣服摩擦声，说话前的吸气声。Interview room sound: quiet room tone, low ventilation far away, clothing rustle, a breath before speaking.

title: 声音：危机现场
text: 危机现场声音：警报一声接一声，听不清的普通话呼叫此起彼伏，脚步声，偶尔有金属撞击，然后突然安静。Crisis sound: alarms repeating, overlapping indistinct Mandarin calls, footsteps, an occasional metal clang, then sudden silence.

title: 声音：水下与头盔
text: 水下声音：头盔里沉重的呼吸，气泡上升的咕噜声，对讲机的电流噪，外界的一切都闷住。Underwater sound: heavy breathing inside a helmet, bubbles rising, radio static, everything outside muffled.

title: 声音：家里的午后
text: 家里午后的声音：窗外远处的城市声，冰箱的低鸣，蜡笔在纸上的沙沙声，孩子的笑。Afternoon at home: distant city through the window, a humming fridge, crayon scratching on paper, a child's laugh.

title: 节奏：纪录片的呼吸
text: 纪录片节奏：动作做完整，台词之间留呼吸，说完以后保持画面一两秒，让剪辑有余量。Documentary pacing: let actions finish, leave breaths between lines, hold the frame a second or two after the last word so the editor has room.

title: 虚实：记忆要模糊，信息要清楚
text: 虚实原则：记忆和资料画面可以软、可以虚，但承载信息的东西（台词时的脸、关键物件、亮起的灯）必须清楚。Focus principle: memory and archive may be soft, but whatever carries the story (the speaking face, the key prop, the light coming on) must be sharp.
